request.subject: ICON:TECH:MARTIAN:SEAMANSHIP

layers.text: Make the big dome on top clear pale lavender-grey glass with one white highlight, not pink, and make the pod's rim polished silver chrome; keep the hot magenta only as the small ring of lights under the pod and the short glowing beam down to the wave. Keep the pod's shape, the blue-white curling wave, the size, the thick black outline and the style, on a transparent background.
